0x00B16C: I<Elemental> machines bound to high spirits; they choose their own operators. Built by Langran to counter threats to all of <La Gias>. Four exist, guarded by Wind, Flame, Water, and Earth.
0x00B2E8: A meteorite that fell in New Era 179 on Aidoneus Island, off the Marquesas Islands in the South Pacific. <EOTI Organization> studies suggest the Aerogaters sent it to Earth deliberately: it appeared suddenly in the L5 sector before falling, decelerated on its own before impact, and held <EOT> sealed inside, packaged to be examined by others. The name follows 'Meteor 1' and 'Meteor 2,' Old Era meteorites that struck New York and Moscow and gravely set back Earth's civilization.
0x00B62C: Short for 'Moon Orbital Search System.' An automated early-warning system of unmanned probes dotted across a sphere bounded by the Moon's orbit. Superior to the Satellite Link System (a satellite air-defense network), it was built by the Colony Integration Army before the DC War; the Federation Army now runs it.
0x00B86B: A world inside the Earth. Though shaped like the inside of a hollow sphere, it is not literally the planet's interior; its phase is shifted from ours. La Gias means 'the true land.'
0x00B9BD: Short for 'Re-Mind Control.' Originally, per-mission memory adjustment and mental control of subjects under memory manipulation or suggestion, such as the <Boosted Children>. Excessive rewriting risks mental collapse, and implanting alien concepts is also dangerous, so related data is normally rewritten gradually. <Boosted Children> keyed by emotions - love, friendship, hostility, grudges - easily exceed their specs.
0x00BCA6: The ReEOTH PLAN. ReEOTH ('Laios') stands for 'Reliable Extra Over Technological Hybrid' - alien technology made highly dependable. The plan fundamentally reworks the unstable <EOT>, raising its reliability and stability by adding Earth's latest technology. Beyond upgrading existing EOT-equipped machines, it aims to bring ReEOTH into successors to the R-Series and future mass-production units.
